verdict.rationale: doola's Registered Agent service, included with every formation, promises same-day scans of received documents and digital access to legal mail through the dashboard. That addresses the 'not waiting on a mail batch' part of the story. However, the only notifications documented are for annual reports, and nothing shows that a lawsuit or service of process specifically triggers an immediate alert, whether email, SMS, or webhook. Missing for 10: explicit immediate notification on service of process, urgent-document prioritization or alert channels, any webhook event for legal mail, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, a lawsuit or other time-sensitive legal notice triggers an immediate notification rather than waiting on a mail batch

citations.quote: Receive local document scans within the same day and enjoy secure storage for all scanned documents
Our Registered Agent service enables you to respond quickly by giving you digital access to physical mail via doola's dashboard.
Legal mail gets an official home from day one.
